messages:
elaine: Quick sync for launch + webinar SEO work. Need owners for: keyword map, Event JSON-LD, internal linking from launch posts to landing/webinar, and redirects for legacy pages. Who can take what?

maria: I can do keyword buckets + two meta title options per page. Will also draft the Event JSON-LD.

devon: I will own redirects and canonical strategy. Post legacy paths and I'll produce nginx rules and a CDN purge checklist.

sam: I'll map internal anchors and CTA UTMs (webinar -> /pricing?plan=inference w/ utm_source=webinar). Will add mid-article link to the benchmark narrative.

tyler: Deploy window for 301s and purges at 22:00 PT. Need final rules by 20:00 PT to stage.

seo-bot: Crawl alert: duplicate title detected at /old-launch/overview and /blog/2023-launch. Recommend 301 -> /products/inference and rel=canonical on blog; webinar page missing Event schema.

elaine: Action list and deadlines: keywords + JSON-LD @maria EOD; redirects rules @devon by 20:00 PT; deploy & CDN purge @tyler 22:00 PT; internal linking + UTMs @sam EOD. Post any other legacy paths here and @devon will add them.
